annotations.title: They decreed.
annotations.text: [1] Beza in his Annotations ( in Ioan. 10. v. 22. ) set forth in English in the yeare. 1603 confesseth that the feast which our Sauiour obserued, was instituted by Iudas Machabeus, and his bretheren, after the restoring of Gods true religion by casting out Antiochus his garrison. [2] It is also cleare that this feast was in winter, ibidem, agreable to the text, [3] in the moneth of Casleu, which is Nouember, wheras the feast of tabernacles was in September, before winter; and the feast of restauration of the temple after the captiuitie of Babylon, was in Adar ( 1. Esd. 6.) which is Februarie, betwen which time and middes of March, was not competent space for those thinges which Christ did after this feast, before his Passion. And therfore it is very strange that Beza, or other Protestantes wil denie these bookes to be Canonical: which haue so excellent a testimonie by the Euangelist of our Sauiours owne fact.

notes.text: Protestantes confesse that Iudas instituted this feast.
It is distinct from other feastes.
